changelog: - **Each Timeline line pattern means one thing.** A run strip's target and what an available timetable offers are now drawn as round dots, at the same width as the run, so they no longer look like a Register's dashes or a dashed series; a Register keeps its dashes, and a dashed series only ever means several tanks that share one colour. Each strip line also carries a word at its end, "target" and "ran" or "available" and "moved", in a space right of the plot that no line crosses, and the two words stay apart when the lines meet. The chart above keeps the same right edge, so a step stands at the same place in both. The strip names, their spoken names and Help say "dotted" in every language.
